invoicing.policy: Invoicing 2.17.0 preserves the locked Parts 1–15 baseline and completes Part 16 Kenya eTIMS fiscalization with company OSCU/VSCU configuration, sandbox/production readiness, hashed fiscal request evidence, provider-agnostic server transport, retry/audit ledgers, fiscal delivery gating, accepted CU/SCU receipt evidence, standalone operator controls, and immutable post-fiscalization PDF snapshots. Future changes must keep Invoicing, ERP integration, platform closure, app-surface, core-hardening, TypeScript, migration dry-run and production deployment gates green.
